joint_generation.daily_level: Fit a shared two-harmonic day-of-year mean and regularized multivariate VAR(1) to five daily aggregates using only fit years; resample or draw innovations jointly, never independently by channel.
joint_generation.intraday_shape: Use two same-season source-day analogues within plus/minus 14 calendar days, selected without replacement among the three closest daily shortwave totals, and blend their five-channel 10-minute profiles with second-analogue weight uniformly 0.20-0.40. Recenter temperature/dewpoint/wind/longwave; scale shortwave by bounded 0.85-1.10 cloudiness factor derived from latent solar level. No post-hoc output clipping.
joint_generation.continuity: Blend non-solar fields across midnight with a 60-minute transition; preserve 10-minute cadence and solar nighttime zeros.
joint_generation.hard_support: Reject nonfinite values, negative wind or radiation, dewpoint more than 1 C above temperature, shortwave above 1500 W/m2, and longwave outside 100-600 W/m2; do not silently clip a generated path into eligibility.
joint_generation.selection: Tune only fixed generator hyperparameters on 2019 weather diagnostics, without using crop or agent outcomes. Document every candidate and selection rule before opening 2020 simulator results.

similarity_audit.normalization: Per-channel standard deviation fitted from 2017-2018 only; freeze with generator hash.
similarity_audit.method: For every generated 24h and 6h window compare against every source window of matching length using all five channels. Reject the complete generated site if any distance is below threshold; record counts and nearest distance, not just accepted sites. Development diagnostic permits at most 20 sequential attempts and reports every physical-support and similarity rejection; no crop outcomes enter selection.
similarity_audit.source_halo: Exclude the prior-year initial 10-minute bootstrap from fit and report it separately.

private_seeds.generation: Generate only after generator implementation, fit statistics, exclusions and similarity audit are frozen.
private_seeds.storage: Outside Git and provider payloads until formal matrix lock; never encode in public campaign_id.
private_seeds.commitment: Record SHA-256 of a salted canonical seed list and generator/config hashes before execution; reveal list and salt only after final matrix lock.

claims: Generated paths are private reality-informed simulation forcing, not measured or validated greenhouse trajectories.
revision_from: candidate-v1 fixed physical shortwave support (0 of first 7 attempts failed), but 6 of first 7 support-valid candidates failed the unchanged 6h non-replay threshold. v2 jointly blends two similar-season/sunlight analogue days rather than lowering the threshold.
